meta.purpose: NBA regression gate. Each fixture is an input the live NBA engine maps to a team. Any future change to src/data/nba.js scoring (or the shared fingerprint engine in src/lib/scoring.js) must reproduce every winner here, or the diff must be reviewed and accepted.
meta.source: Generated from the live NBA fingerprint matrix at the sport-four convergence build (30 teams, 12 module questions). NBA is a fingerprint sport like NFL and MLB: coreProfile vs teamDims plus module-point tiebreakers. All 30 signatures self-land; centroid gravity well is CLE (not ATL); no magnet on a 60k uniform sweep.
meta.synthetic_caveat: Signatures pin coreProfile to each team's own teamDims and use that team's signature module answers; they measure ENGINE BEHAVIOR (reachability), not real-taker prevalence. Random fixtures are seeded uniform draws and are snapshots of engine output, not predictions of how real people answer. Reachability is not prevalence.
meta.signature_method: coreProfile = teamDims; moduleAnswers = the option the team sits in per choice question, strong end of its slider camp, neutral 3 where the team is off the slider.
